comment: Upstream provenance for every OpenChamber patch in the queue. `relationship` says what an upstream release would mean for this patch: same (we shipped this change, or upstream did), alternative (upstream shipped a different design for the same need, so the patch needs reconciling rather than porting), partial (upstream took part of it), pending (a PR or issue is open and nothing has shipped), none (local only, no upstream counterpart). `mergedAs` is the merge commit when one exists. `intent` says what the patch deserves upstream: bugfix (a broken thing upstream owns), feature, personal (stays local), testing (wants more use before deciding) or declined (the maintainer refused it). `since` is the date this record was last checked. Update this file whenever a patch is added, dropped or re-expressed; scripts/openchamber-upstream.sh fails when a queued patch has no record here. `follows` lists the earlier patches whose own lines this patch rewrites; scripts/assert-openchamber-patch-overlap.mjs fails a patch that rewrites another patch's lines without listing it.

android-notification-dismiss.note: Opening a session removes its own delivered phone banners, and the subagent banners under it. Checked against #7381 and #7274 on the new base and left in place: #7381 does not clear a session's own banners, and #7274's family walk only overlaps getSessionFamilyIds when the server is reachable. The native push loader awaited a Capacitor plugin proxy, which is thenable, so the first await never settled; loadNativePush now returns plain functions over the plugin, with a test that drives a real proxy. PR #6805 was withdrawn on 2026-11-20 because the native push path was never observed on a device; issue #6803 is open, so it returns once there is device evidence.

attention-stale-form.note: A question tool call that ends in error sends no settlement event, so the host's cross-directory index kept the form and every surface announced an answered question. Both halves now check a pending form against OpenCode's own form list before showing it. Kept, and it goes upstream with instance-attention once Jeremy is happy with that work.

chat-width-80.note: A fourth chat width, Extra wide (80rem), between Wider and Full. Upstream owns the setting now (default/wider/full, migrated in v29); this re-expresses the 80rem level on top of it. Kept indefinitely by Jeremy's choice.

commandcode-quota.note: Local-only provider. Upstream removed Command Code quota in 1.21.0 (its official API exposes no usage data) and declined to restore it; this reads the web app's own billing routes with a browser session token. Ported onto main's TypeScript provider module.

context-row-icons.note: A collapsed quote renders captionless, so it was a bar and some text; the question card was the same shape, so quotes and questions read the same at a glance. This carries only the question half: the question line gets its own mark, placed in the row rather than above it, because line-clamp sets display:-webkit-box and beats flex, so the clamp belongs on the text. The quote half is upstream code and was dropped by choice.

dictation-recovery.note: Upstream #7532 merged the origin-keying half: a transcript no longer lands in whatever composer is on screen. Main had also lost the #404 dictate-link flow, so the port keeps that alone: the pendingDraftDictation store members, usePendingDraftDictation, the deepLinks dictate intent, the deepLinkNavigation request and the ChatInput wiring, plus the empty-result and retry gating in useDictation. mobile-voice-launch owns the deepLinks parsing, so this patch does not repeat it.

draft-heading-project-picker.note: The project's name in a new-session heading is a second way into the composer's project picker. Kept indefinitely by Jeremy's choice, and going upstream: a feature request plus a PR are being prepared. Ported onto main's ComposerDraftTitle and DraftWelcome, where the request travels through a store because the welcome renders the heading in another component.

gitea-references-across.note: The reference picker's search across a folder's repositories for Gitea and Forgejo, which have no API that names a set of repositories: a page is read per folder and merged by activity. 48 files. Ported onto main's provider-resource contract (referencesAcross in the descriptor, provider and routes) and its TypeScript settings/client modules.

hide-empty-worktrees.note: A worktree nobody has used yet (no session, no draft, no pin, no archived session) can be left out of the sidebar. A search still finds it. Local: the setting is ours.

image-viewer-zoom.note: Pinch, double-tap and wheel zoom with pan for the image viewer, on top of upstream's fit levels. Ported onto main's imageZoom module and ToolOutputDialog. The old record cited PR #321, which does not resolve in the upstream repository, and no open issue covers it, so a feature request has to exist before this can go upstream.

in-work-paging.note: In work ranks its rows by what needs the user (a waiting answer, then a running turn, then unread or looks-done) from the live turn and request indexes only, so a recency update does not re-run it. Local.

in-work-paging-show-more.note: In work opens with its own page size (a stored per-surface number) and Show more adds the same number again, separate from the sidebar's session batch size. Kept for now.

instance-attention.note: Cross-instance attention: desktop and mobile poll the saved hosts and the app's own server and show one merged, ordered list of sessions that need the user. 69 files, mostly new modules. Kept: Jeremy will upstream it once he is happy with it. Carries two fixes folded in rather than queued separately: the drawer applied this instance's folder rule to a saved host's sessions, and a host switch cleared the session list so the instance on screen published no rows until the sheets opened.

mobile-assist-trigger.note: Android assist and deep-link launch: the launch intent is rewritten before the bridge reads it, and an assist tap opens a new draft. Kept for the power-button assist launch; a feature request follows.

mobile-voice-launch.note: openchamber://new-session?dictate=1 starts dictation in the draft it names, bound to the draft's id so it never records in another. Its new-session and dictate shortcuts will be reworked under accepted upstream #6554, so this patch follows that design rather than asking for its own.

pdf-viewer-zoom.note: Zoom for the pdf.js fallback where the runtime has no built-in PDF viewer (the Android WebView): the image viewer's controls, a two-finger pinch and Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, repainting pages at a capped canvas size. Builds on image-viewer-zoom. PR #7464 is open upstream work waiting on feature request #6113: the intake bot closed the PR until the request is accepted, and it reopens on its own when it is. The patch stays in the queue meanwhile.

question-cards.note: The card itself: every option with the chosen one marked, a typed answer as one more row, and a working turn's fold preview drawing the card in step order. Folded in from the separate bubble and one-shape patches: the card draws the prompt bubble itself (message/body/userBubbleStyle.ts) with the question colour in its fill, so it stays opaque, and every card uses one shape - a question line with its answer under it, the rest behind a count - whatever the count or open state. Issue #7108 closed as fixed by #7109, so a feature request is needed before this can be accepted upstream.

question-indicator.note: Draft PR #7560 is open for issue #6809. It draws the permission shield and question mark through one shared component with its own question colour role, and because it builds on stale-pending-badge's remaining switcher and collapsed-folder marks, the draft also carries that remainder of #6802.

question-rows.note: A question call becomes its own row in the transcript instead of a tool row: answered ones stick under their prompt and end its sticky span, waiting ones read as a card. Ported onto main's timeline: the row is cut in timelineRows.ts, the sticky rules live in stickyPrompt.ts, and the card is the row's body so the turn footer and a stopped turn's failure text stay. Issue #7108 closed as fixed by #7109, so a feature request is needed before this can be accepted upstream.

recap-full-note.note: A UI preference: the recap ends the transcript instead of lying over the gap above the composer, so the whole note stays readable. Kept indefinitely by Jeremy's choice. Ported onto main's ChatViewport listFooter.

reply-start-scroll.note: PR #7561 is open for issue #6808. The pill's up arrow walks back to the nearest reply whose prose starts above the viewport, past the tool rows that led to it. Ported onto main's timeline handle: useNavigationSettle gained a measurement re-arm and a through-list scroll, and TimelineList/useMessageListHandle own the new handle methods. The PR body carries a gist recording with the tap marker.

session-entry-position.note: A per-surface choice of where a session opens: the remembered position, the start of the last reply, or the conversation start. It reuses reply-start-scroll's reply start, and a session that is still working opens at its end. Issue #6808 covers the reply-start landing only; whether the entry-position choice belongs upstream is its call.

stale-pending-badge.note: Upstream #7530 merged the sync-layer half: a row's badge now answers from the directory store once it has read its own requests, and from the cross-directory index before that. The port keeps only what #7530 did not take: the mobile and desktop switcher pending marks, collapsed-folder scoped counting, and the selectIndexedBlockingRequests and settleGlobalBlockingRequest helpers with their tests and documentation. PR #6804 was withdrawn on 2026-11-20; issue #6802 stays open, and the remainder now goes upstream as part of question-indicator's draft PR #7560.

attention-jump-landing.note: Clicking a row for another instance in the attention dialog switched host but opened the session last open there: the switch restored the remembered session, the outgoing App wrote it into the URL, and the remounted App replayed that URL over the clicked one. The click now holds the session for the target runtime key and opens it once the switch has landed and that one session can be read; restores and the sidebar's selection stand aside while it is held. Also ports a sidebar fix (keep a session whose project has no rows yet instead of opening a draft), makes relay activation report whether it switched, and stops the host list above the rows from growing after the dialog opens. Builds on instance-attention, so it goes upstream with it.

tray-instances.note: The desktop tray showed whichever window last pushed a snapshot, kept a closed window's rows, and answered Allow/Deny through the main window's instance. Main now keeps one snapshot per window, groups the menu by instance and routes every row to the window that supplied it. Also: an empty snapshot while a host switch loads, stale-runtime events dropped from global stores, a loaded directory's requests win over the global index, the tray and sidebar share one row rule, and revoking a desktop-local client from a remote window no longer touches this machine. Bugs found in an audit, not in daily use. Upstream plan: the bug fixes as a PR, the per-instance grouping as a feature request first.

attention-row-parity.note: The attention popover built another instance's rows with its own rule: it read only the wire parentID, so an operator child whose parent link lives in metadata, sitting in a /tmp/opencode worktree, was listed from cedar although navi's own sidebar and popover hid it. Both paths now call the sidebar's row rule with each instance's own data, and a failed or partial read shows sessions rather than hiding them. Builds on instance-attention, so it goes upstream with it.

catalog-refresh-in-use.note: Every running OpenCode location announces a config change, and the catalog refresh re-read agents, commands, providers and directory config for each one, so an OpenCode restart during the refresh booted every announcing location again. The refresh now reads only directories in use (current, viewed, bootstrap demand, active project, settings, the Projects page selection and the chats root) and invalidates the caches of the rest and marks their stores stale, so opening one re-reads it. Exported from 653b63caa on upstream main 3853549df; on 62f77fbfa only the ModelSelector.tsx hunk offset differs (its imports differ there). Also part of #7494. No upstream PR yet.

html-document-etag.note: express.static validated index.html, mobile.html and mini-chat.html by size and mtime, and the SPA fallback did the same through res.sendFile. Nix stamps every build output with the same mtime, so two builds whose documents had the same size sent the same weak ETag, the server on the new build answered 304 to a browser holding the old document, and that browser kept loading the old build's immutable hashed assets. The static routes now read each root HTML document and send it with res.send (an ETag over the bytes), Cache-Control: no-cache and no Last-Modified; express.static runs with index: false so / reaches the SPA fallback. Exported from 1af3df3f9 on 62f77fbfa. The upstream issue and PR are being drafted; none is open yet.

candidates.name: chat-small-image-upscale
candidates.note: The chat's tool-output dialog draws a picture larger than its own pixels at fit: a 64x64 icon renders near 1055%, where the files preview never upscales. No local patch yet.
